stock.description: Soundwill Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, conducting various property-related activities within the People's Republic of China. Its primary business includes real estate development, property rentals, and delivering building management services. The firm constructs a diverse portfolio of properties, encompassing medium to high-end commercial, residential, and industrial sites. It also provides comprehensive management, repair, and maintenance solutions for both extensive commercial buildings and residential communities of varying sizes. Beyond development, Soundwill Holdings actively invests in and leases commercial, office, and residential properties, alongside advertising and compact storage spaces. The company additionally facilitates property assembly and sales. Established in 1978, its headquarters are located in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and it operates as a subsidiary of Ko Bee Limited.
